summary: Missing cart totals when coupon service timed out
root_cause: Coupon timeout fallback returned empty totals instead of retry-safe warning
impact: 18 support cases and temporary checkout confusion
postmortem_decisions: Decision: all checkout failures include retry-safe guidance
action_items: Update support macro and add coupon timeout regression test

summary: P95 latency exceeded 700ms at 50 percent routing
root_cause: Cold Redis cache plus slow checkout price query
impact: Error rate peaked at 1.2 percent and conversion dropped to 3.1 percent
postmortem_decisions: Decision: no route increase unless cache warmup runs and p95 latency stays below 450ms
action_items: Add cache warmup job and Monday slow query review

summary: Database connection pool saturation during promotion traffic
root_cause: Reporting queries competed with checkout writes and connection usage hit 92 percent
impact: Checkout latency rose to 655ms p95, 186 slow queries per hour
postmortem_decisions: Decision: reporting queries must use read replica before 75 percent routing
action_items: Move reporting to replica and lower slow query alert threshold

summary: Inventory reservation timeout caused checkout abandonment spike
root_cause: Inventory dependency timed out and retry budget amplified customer wait
impact: 1240 failed checkout attempts and error rate 1.8 percent
postmortem_decisions: Decision: fail fast with circuit breaker and clear retry state
action_items: Deploy circuit breaker and run load test before 100 percent cutover

summary: Mobile Safari p99 latency spike after 100 percent cutover
root_cause: Synchronous address validation script blocked checkout submit on mobile Safari
impact: p99 latency reached 1190ms and support saw 27 mobile checkout cases
postmortem_decisions: Decision: address validation must run async and submit button remains retry safe
action_items: Add Safari regression check to release checklist

summary: Brief alert for elevated error rate during catalog deploy
root_cause: Catalog deploy caused noisy checkout anomaly alert without customer impact
impact: Error rate reached 0.58 percent for 9 minutes but uptime stayed 99.98
postmortem_decisions: Decision: tune alert to require 15 minute burn window
action_items: Adjust Grafana alert rule and Teams notification text

root_cause: Retry reversal records were excluded from April refund report
impact: Finance reconciliation delayed and ATLAS-134 remained blocked
postmortem_decisions: Decision: no monolith archive until finance signs off
action_items: Patch refund reversal report and backfill April data
